scope: 1497 upstream PR heads and 69 pre-existing fork branches, including reachable intermediate and former-path versions
sli_rec_half_mask: All 3 PyTorch source versions share the same overflowing torch.full_like(_MASK_PADDING) implementation; 10 legacy versions use the same sentinel in TensorFlow.
sli_rec_log_softmax: 2 PyTorch source versions share separate softmax/log. 47 legacy branch observations in 102 base_model and 20 sequential_base_model versions reduce to 3 formatting/API variants, all separate softmax/log.
xdeepfm_zero_norm: All 6 PyTorch versions use sqrt(mse) for square_loss and sqrt(sum(square)) for CIN regularization.
sli_rec_recency: All 15 reachable source blobs under sli_rec.py and sli_rec_pytorch.py use the final padded time_to_now column; former filename versions and intermediate commits were explicitly checked.
sequential_metric_direction: All 2 PyTorch sequential-base and 20 historical TensorFlow sequential-base versions initialize best_metric=0 and maximize every eval_metric; no minimum-error direction.

rnn_cell.finding: Both full-width scans; no earlier bounded recurrence.

sli_rec.finding: Former-suffix versions retain the out-of-range half sentinel and final padded recency column.

sequential_base.finding: Former-suffix versions retain softmax-then-log, maximize every checkpoint metric and reshape ranking groups per batch.

other_published_models.finding: Full historical filename enumeration found no formerly renamed dkn.py, xdeepfm.py/xDeepFM.py or lightgbm_utils.py basenames beyond the audited current and historical paths.

cross_batch_groups: All 4 PyTorch sequential-base variants and 20 TensorFlow sequential-base-model variants reshape groups per batch. No equivalent cross-batch grouping change found.

excluded_homogeneous_negative_sampling.reason: Earlier source version bounded rejection sampling and raised on exhausted candidates. Treat same nontermination root cause as already submitted. No new issue or patch.

rlrmc_pair_predictions.finding: All reachable predict implementations preserve the same incorrect low-memory mean sign and duplicate-collapsing sparse prediction; former paths and intermediate commits included.

dkn_item2item_normalization.finding: Only one PyTorch source variant, using score-dtype square/rsqrt with epsilon 1e-12; 15 former TensorFlow variants use tf.math.l2_normalize and float32 layer weights. No earlier PyTorch low-precision promotion.

geoimc_prediction_factorization.finding: All variants call sqrtm(W[1]) separately for user and item embeddings; prior fork branches only adjust top-k edge handling.

geoimc_length_normalization.finding: All variants square input directly before division; zero-row protection already present, so zero-row handling is not a new candidate.
geoimc_length_normalization.counting_decision: Do not submit or count as a separate improvement in this round: overlaps the row-vector normalization stability theme of DKN PR #2467. Independent review agreed despite different backends and scaling algorithms. Existing zero-row guard is not novel.

cin_mask_smaller_operand.reason: Historical TensorFlow xDeepFM source already proposes the same filter masking algebra in commented code: filters_in_use = tf.multiply(filters, mask_matrix) * 2. Do not count backend port/adaptive operand selection as independent new contribution under user requirement.

slirec_native_device_migration.reason: All native module variants retain initialization-time device metadata; no migration-aware property or _apply synchronization found. Different from LightGCN adjacency registration root cause.
slirec_native_device_migration.compatibility: Remove direct device assignment in existing #2453 CPU attention test; explicitly move loader result to CPU, preserving that test on GPU hosts and with dynamic device property.

ffm_field_aliasing.decision: No prior per-instance field bounds validation; current global flattened bounds miss inter-instance aliasing. Eight real failures, five valid-sparse model controls, full40pass locally.
